scope: Shape-only; no Surface ranker, appearance loss, RGB correction, or combined run
gpu_policy: Request the highest GPU exposed to the authenticated account; prefer H100 over A100; record actual allocation and availability before training
data: COCOA train2014 amodal annotations; exclude every benchmark COCO image ID, byte/decoded duplicate, and aligned-thumbnail near duplicate across all benchmark sources
split: SHA256(shape-v2-20261123:<image_id>), first 8 hex digits modulo 10: 0 validation, 1 untouched geometry holdout, 2-9 training; same-image objects stay together

planned_inference_policy.selection: maximum expected mask intersection/union against the predicted probability mask; exclude empty masks; seed-order ties and slot 0 fallback
planned_inference_policy.status: scoring function implemented; progressive runtime integration pending trained checkpoint
planned_inference_policy.freeze: Any validation-driven revision must be recorded before opening the reserved holdout or running the benchmark

training.selection: maximum validation image-mean hidden IoU; full IoU breaks exact ties; no benchmark or holdout checkpoint selection
training.loss: BCE + full Dice + hidden Dice + 0.5 hidden positive BCE
training.augmentation: horizontal flips; 50% extra half-plane/rectangle/ellipse occlusion; visible-based crop padding 1.5-3.0; original amodal target
training.inputs: RGB only inside visible support, visible mask, unknown mask; neutralize unobserved pixels before bilinear resizing

success.denominators: Preserve established failure penalties for LPIPS/VGG/SSIM; CLIP follows the established successful-output protocol with explicit coverage and shared-success diagnostic
success.uncertainty: paired source-stratified image bootstrap, 5000 draws, seed 20261110; report nominal intervals separately from the point threshold
success.reference_control: identical frozen scoring references for the candidate and control; never select a checkpoint or selector on benchmark scores
success.generalization: Existing benchmark outcomes are known; this is an iterated benchmark result, not a new untouched confirmatory test
